Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in the statistics section caused the weighted reliability calculator to fail validation.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical values. This error typically indicates a misspelled function name or a reference to a non-existent named range in the generated workbook. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations in the 'Task' sheet (rows 46-47) are broken. Avoid using Excel functions that require specific add-ins or are unavailable in the target environment's evaluator.
